verdict.rationale:
Azure's control plane is built on Azure Resource Manager, exposed via REST APIs (azure-docs-4/5/23), with CLI, SDKs, ARM templates, Bicep, and Terraform all layered on that same API (azure-docs-6/7/8/9/21), and a community comment confirms 'almost everything can be done via command line' (azure-comm-15). Cost management, RBAC, and identity are also API-accessible (azure-docs-10/12/13/14/22).
missing for 10: an explicit vendor statement guaranteeing 100% UI/API parity, and independent verification that no portal-only features exist.
